title: Разгруппировка
semantics: PROPOSAL, not implemented: retain shares. Seasonal uses two inputs, Group links and one datetime order field on each input, integer Total/Weight and string Item. Select native seasonal method, year x1, 12 indices, rare_density .25, absent_periods 1, novelty_periods 1, max_history_periods 0. Execute recomputes current inputs. Output 0 adds Period, confidence bounds, trend, seasonal factor, value code and text; numeric detail/trend/bounds remain integer for this fixture. Output 1: Item,Group,UngroupQuality,SeasonalIndex1..12 (real metrics). Constant support 1:3 gives 25/75 and unit indices, quality NULL. All-zero support produces zero/excluded code6 and quality1; NULL-only/empty support or empty totals gives empty both ports. Proposed acceptance explicitly projects out confidence bounds; their formula and nonconstant estimator lack an independent oracle. Calendar alternatives/none exist in UI but are outside this initial proposal. Preserve port identity and exact types; no JavaScript substitute. No seasonal support before owner approval and stage1.

parameter_schema.description: Proposed shares/seasonal settings. Seasonal proposal requires complete ungroup plus seasonality; existing {} preserves supported saved settings.

ungroup.description: Complete role selection; keys are group links only. Seasonal order fields belong to seasonality, not keys.

keys.description: Ordered complete group links: totals input 0 to support input 1. Exact observed names, compatible scalar types. NULL keys match NULL; empty string is distinct. Totals require exactly one row per composite key; duplicates cause native execution refusal.

support.description: Matching group field on support input 1.

value_field.description: One continuous integer/real total field on input 0. NULL totals produce no detail rows.

item_field.description: One string position-name field on input 1; exact technical name, retained in output. NULL names are retained.

share_field.description: Exact numeric support field. shares uses supplied fractions; seasonal uses historical values, not ready-made indices.

rounding.description: Explicit rounding policy; rounds the group total too.

format.description: Native rounding: none; precision decimal places; multiple positive integer step. Ties 2.5 -> 2 observed at precision 0.

value.description: Required for precision/multiple, omitted for none. Proposed supported precision 0..12; multiple 1..2147483647. Reject incompatible range before UI.

balance.description: Native balance method: no correction, all remainder to last item, proportional, or equal. Order is the support order within each totals row. Pin exact examples in acceptance; never normalize silently.

seasonality.description: Proposal: annual/monthly constant history only. All settings explicit; alternate periods/none and point-depth settings require separate acceptance.

total_order_field.description: Datetime order field on input 0; Period.

support_order_field.description: Datetime order field on input 1; Period.

index_count.description: Number of SeasonalIndex columns; UI minimum 3, proposed 12.

novelty_periods.description: Periods present for a new position.
